summary: Per-frame update of a HUD scoring/progress-bar element: decrements a countdown timer, encodes expired scoring events into a 432-byte ring buffer, advances a linked event list, interpolates the display alpha toward its target, applies a time-of-day dimming factor and day/night light toggle, computes an interpolated RGB color ramp, and updates audio pan, a bounded float setter and a UI element position. Also swaps idle/active state ids (6<->7, 21<->22) in a global element array when the smoothed value moves.

local_names.v11: ring-buffer slot for an encoded event

Gate for the event/expiry block: (dword_7C56A0 & 1) != 0 and dword_8AB6E4 != 2.
On timer expiry (v2 < 0): if the one-shot byte this+64 is set, clear it, StringCopyWithRingBuffer(this+264) and set this+68 = -8388609.
Build ADSR envelope inputs (1.0 - this+4) * this+0 and dbl_8AFEA0 * this+0, then AudioADSREnvelope(v37, v38, dword_5C329C).
Reset the countdown timer this+4 to 1.0 (literal 1065353216).

Emit a new event when the cached value this+68 differs from dbl_8AFEA0 by more than 2.5, or when this+72..80 differs from v49 (memcmp of 12 bytes).
ProgressBarEventEncode into a 432-byte ring-buffer slot at dword_8AAE64 (slot count bounded by dword_83EE60 < 1023); copy v49 into the slot payload and cache this+72/76/80 and this+68.

Linked event list: if the head node *(this+92) is non-null and its timestamp *(node+0) is less than dbl_8AFEA0, encode a type-2 (node+4==1) or type-3 event via ProgressBarEventEncode, store alpha byte = CRTFtol(node+8 * 255.0), then advance *(this+92) to the node's next pointer *(node+4).
Alpha smoothing: when this+4 > 0, this+8 = (1.0 - f) * this+8 + f * this+32 with f = dbl_8AFE98 / (dbl_8AFE98 + this+4); otherwise this+8 = this+32.
Base alpha: if this+8 >= 1.0, v42 = 1.0 - this+252 - (this+256 - this+252) * this+36; else v42 = 1.0 - this+252 * this+8.

Time-of-day dimming when flt_7CFEC4 < 1.0: compute v15 = dbl_8AFEA0 * this+0 + flt_8ACFB0, call InterruptDispatch(v15), derive the day factor v45 from the 14400/64800/72000 boundaries, multiply v42 by v45, RenderColorUpdate(this+264, v45), and toggle the nightlight flag this+16 when v15 leaves the 19800..66600 window - enumerating objects via CameraPositionGetter, LinkedListNthElement, LinkedIndexedAccess, sub_588640 and BitFlagSetterWithDXUpdate with the aNightlight string.

When fabs(this+12 - v42) > 0.017999999: LinkedListTraversal(0), clamp v42 into [0.0, 1.0], store this+12 = v42 and UIPropertyValueSetter(2, ...).
Position delta: v44 = clamp((this+44 - this+40) * 4.0) into [0.0, 1.0]; if fabs(this+164 - v44) > 0.003, store this+164 = v44 and StridedArraySearchAndCall(&dword_8ACEA0, 10, v44).

Color ramp: when v26 >= this+168 lerp the high range ((this+240..244..248) - (this+228..232..236)) and ((this+204..208..212) - (this+192..196..200)) by v29 = (v26 - this+168) * this+176; else lerp the low range ((this+228..232..236) - (this+216..220..224)) and ((this+192..196..200) - (this+180..184..188)) by v27 = v26 * this+172; outputs feed audio/position/UI.
Output stage: AudioPanUpdate(v44, v45), BoundedFloatSetterWithFlag(v43), scale v46/v47/v48 by 255.0 through CRTFtol into the v41/v39/v30 words, and UIElementPositionSetter(v30, v39, v41).
